title: Where I've built.
sub: Across startups, enterprises, and everything in between.

roles.title: Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Owned end-to-end feature development for Nym4Business, a multi-tenant B2B platform providing financial infrastructure to SMEs and organizations.
Developed a configurable approval-rule engine supporting custom transaction conditions with multi-approver logic across roles and individuals.
Developed two-factor authentication and audit-logging mechanisms integrated with NymCard's core payment systems.
Built dashboards and GraphQL APIs facilitating management and data access across role and permission hierarchies.

roles.title: Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Developed core backend services powering Korn Ferry Talent Suite, a global HR-Tech platform serving thousands of organizations across 150+ countries.
Designed an internal-routing system for inter-service communication, reducing inter-service latency by up to 70% and overall latency by up to 40%, without requiring any handler layer changes.
Built a streaming export system for multi-gigabyte audit-log CSVs, reconstructing data in real time to minimize server memory use and eliminate storage costs.
Designed an advanced request-tracing system delivering detailed traces, including database and HTTP calls, with no added processing or network overhead in response pipelines.

roles.title: Founding Engineer & Tech Lead
bullets: Led the development of a two-sided marketplace platform - architecting and owning most of the backend and frontend development while leading a team of three from initial design through production deployment.

Designed a hybrid geolocation + address-based search system (map, radius, and structured address queries) alongside a dynamic inheritance-based CMS giving granular per-category control over listing fields, pricing packages, and limits.
Built a real-time chat and notification system with per-listing conversation identity, live presence, and real-time listing updates.
Architected a Stripe-integrated wallet and recurring payment system, implementing a hybrid transaction ledger supporting direct payments, account credits, and automated subscription renewals.

roles.title: Full-Stack Engineer
bullets: Mentored 100+ developers worldwide, working with individuals across experience levels, from programming beginners to experienced engineers seeking guidance in software development and system design.

Developed full-stack applications across the TypeScript ecosystem, leveraging technologies including React, Next.js, React Native, Node.js, Express, GraphQL, and WebSockets to deliver end-to-end solutions.
Worked across diverse product domains, including a gaming companion application, a tournament hosting and management platform, and an educational technology platform, among others.
